residualCold.explanation: Residual direct-cold time is dominated by the initial authenticated authoritative Firestore server read/handshake, not Cobros renderer CPU. After the first authoritative server snapshot, the critical Cobros dependency set completes in about one second.
residualCold.integrityBoundary: Do not relax authoritativeFirstReadRequired or substitute cache-only readiness to reduce this number. That would change the certified fail-closed read contract.
residualCold.humanRelevance: Normal in-session navigation with hydrated store is measured at 380.6 ms usable and zero new store events. Targeted human proof is required to validate perceived entry performance on Paula's real browser/session.

decision.reason: The demonstrated Cobros-specific bottleneck is removed; remaining cold-first-server latency belongs to the authoritative startup/read boundary and requires real-browser perception before any broader startup change.
